energy.census: Positive collecting candidates from the measured, settled per-electrode ADC step.
energy.channel_qualification: Every required strip has a measured uncontaminated slow plateau at or above the existing collection threshold.
energy.guard_scope: Guard collection in the current measured step withholds the strip-face total.
energy.scope: Average the separate X and Y sums after closure. The result measures aggregate energy for one observed ADC trigger.
energy.unassigned_slow_scope: An unassigned clean hit at or above threshold withholds a new total. An already qualified single-strip pair retains its measured energy.

design.fast_baseline: Mean of the last three quiet fast samples through the reference. Signed area uses the nominal pulser gain.
design.fixed_pair_reference: Diagnostic gates anchored to the original pair trigger for all variants. Each recorded trigger also has features at its own reference. Deltas are pair minus the indicated retained component.
design.history: Original known analog history within 40 feedback time constants of the focused slice. Earlier known tails omitted. The focused slice lies outside unavailable-history exclusions. The same history is held in all three variants.
design.noise: Original per-contact Gaussian draws at the absolute clock indices. Baseline is the original ADC preamble mean.

native_design.endpoints: Deposit rows grouped by saved SSD carrier contact membership. Local centroids use deposited-energy weights. Terminal induced signals can also occur on electrodes without assigned carrier endpoints.
native_design.stage: Signed native current integrated over the original intervals. Values are induced-charge equivalents, separate from the slow ADC energy.
native_design.threshold: Apply the inclusive positive cut to each final wired electrode value after summing when combined.
